opportunities.name: JetBlue flight search
opportunities.description: Search JetBlue flights from an origin to a destination with trip type and depart/return dates, then sort/filter results by price.
steps: Enter From city and pick suggestion
Enter To city and pick suggestion
Choose trip type (roundtrip/one-way)
Select depart (and return) dates
Click Search flights and continue to results
Open Sort & Filter, sort by price low to high, Apply

instances.values: New York -> Miami, depart 27, return 31, points filter
New York -> Toronto, one-way, depart 29, sort price low to high
New York -> Aruba, return May 5, sort price low to high

opportunities.name: Budget careers job search
opportunities.description: On Budget careers site, filter openings by Country, Team and Time Type, then search and open a job.
steps: Click Careers then Openings
Open Country filter, search and select country
Open Team filter, search and select team
Open Time Type filter, search and select type
Click search by job title or keyword
Open a job posting

instances.values: USA, Finance, Full time; Accounts Payable Associate

opportunities.name: United car rental search
opportunities.description: Search United car rentals by pickup location, pickup/drop-off dates and times.
steps: Click CAR tab
Enter pickup city and select suggestion
Click Pickup and select start and end dates
Optionally set pickup/drop-off times
Click Find cars

opportunities.name: Product search with max price and add to cart
opportunities.description: Search a retailer for a product, set a maximum price, and add a result to cart.
steps: Type product keyword in search box and submit
Enter maximum price and apply
Open a result
Click Add to Cart

opportunities.name: NPS find a park by activity/topic
opportunities.description: Use NPS Find a Park search by activity or topic and run the search.
steps: Click FIND A PARK
Click Search by Activity or Topic
Choose Activity or Topic tab
Select an item in the input
Click Search
